This page reports published MetagenomicsBench scores from benchmarks.bio. MetagenomicsBench contains 100 evaluations built from real experimental data, each one graded deterministically against the biological result the original analysis reached, so a run counts as a pass only when the agent recovers that result rather than when it produces plausible-looking output. Results are reported per model and per harness rather than per model alone, because the harness an agent runs under changes its score substantially. Scores use a 0-100 percentage scale and are not comparable across benchmarks; see the linked repository and paper for task construction, grading, and confidence-interval methodology.
